business_summary: Mattel, Inc., a play and family entertainment company, designs, manufactures, markets, and sells toys, games, and other products in North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers dolls and accessories, books, content, and lifestyle products for children under the Barbie, American Girl, Disney Princess, Disney Frozen, Monster High, Polly Pocket, and KPop Demon Hunters brands; die-cast vehicles, tracks, playsets, and accessories for kids, adults, and collectors under the Hot Wheels, Hot Wheels Monster Trucks, Hot Wheels RC, Matchbox, and Matchbox, and Cars brands; and infant, toddler, and preschool products comprising toys, content, live events, and other consumer products under the Fisher-Price, Little People, Thomas & Friends, and Power Wheels brands. It also provides action figures, building sets, games, and other products under the Masters of the Universe, Mattel Brick Shop, MEGA, UNO, Jurassic World, Minecraft, WWE, Toy Story, Star Wars, Pictionary, Skip-Bo, Phase 10, and Blokus brands; and licensor partner brands, including Disney Pixar, Microsoft, NBCUniversal, and WWE. The company sells its products to retailers, including omnichannel retailers, discount and free-standing toy stores, chain stores, department stores, and other retail outlets; wholesalers; and directly to consumers through retail spaces, boutique stores, agents and distributors, and its e-commerce platforms and third-party e-commerce channels. Mattel, Inc. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in El Segundo, California.
business_summary_ko: 놀이 및 가족 엔터테인먼트 회사인 Mattel, Inc.는 북미, 유럽, 중동, 아프리카, 라틴 아메리카 및 아시아 태평양 지역에서 장난감, 게임 및 기타 제품을 디자인, 제조, 마케팅 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 Barbie, American Girl, Disney Princess, Disney Frozen, Monster High, Polly Pocket 및 KPop Demon Hunters 브랜드로 어린이를 위한 인형, 액세서리, 도서, 콘텐츠 및 라이프스타일 제품을 제공합니다. Hot Wheels, Hot Wheels Monster Trucks, Hot Wheels RC, Matchbox, Matchbox 및 Cars 브랜드의 어린이, 성인 및 수집가를 위한 다이캐스트 차량, 트랙, 플레이 세트 및 액세서리; Fisher-Price, Little People, Thomas & Friends 및 Power Wheels 브랜드의 장난감, 콘텐츠, 라이브 이벤트 및 기타 소비자 제품으로 구성된 영유아 및 미취학 아동용 제품. 또한 Masters of the Universe, Mattel Brick Shop, MEGA, UNO, Jurassic World, Minecraft, WWE, Toy Story, Star Wars, Pictionary, Skip-Bo, Phase 10 및 Blokus 브랜드로 액션 피규어, 빌딩 세트, 게임 및 기타 제품을 제공합니다. Disney Pixar, Microsoft, NBCUniversal 및 WWE를 포함한 라이센스 제공자 파트너 브랜드. 회사는 다음을 포함한 소매업체에 제품을 판매합니다.
